_source: VAV-2a (2026-11-19): the hvac_vav_box config keys of the sheet rules (B3 / B4 / QR-C1 own_row_check, B5 integrator_cabling, B6 existing_boxes), B9 combination_warning, the B7 section qty_attr, and the VAV-2a Pricing Inputs. Word tables = VAV-D0 D4 (d4_crosssheet.py / d4_qr4a_final.py, the agreed QR-4 (a) test) and chat-Claude's v3 cabling test (owner 01:29 / 01:34 / 01:39). Read by the vav2a* tests and by the HVAC v77 mint (scripts/_instruments/mint_hvac_v77_vav2a.py) -- the one copy.

lines.not_added: {extra} is priced on its own row of this sheet ({rows}) - not added to this row. Add it here if this row should also include it.
lines.double_count: {extra} added - possible double counting - also priced in {rows}.
lines.rate_only: {extra} is priced on its own row of this sheet ({rows}) - not added to this row (the quantities are blank or 0, so the separate row decides). Add it here if this row should also include it.
lines.attr_changed: The VAV integrator is priced on its own row of this sheet ({rows}) - this box is priced on the 'Integrator Included = No' line.
lines.threshold_missing: (The Pricing Input 'VAV - own-row threshold' is not set, so it was added.)

lines.added: {qty} m of integrator cabling added per box - no separate integrator cabling row naming VAV found on this sheet. Remove it if not needed.
lines.priced_separately: Integrator cabling is priced on its own row of this sheet ({rows}) - not added to this row.
lines.low_length: Integrator cabling is priced on its own row of this sheet ({rows}) - not added to this row. Its quantity looks low ({metres} m against {need} m = {per_box} m x {boxes} VAV boxes, below {pct}%): check the cabling quantity and add the cabling price to this row if required.
lines.input_missing: Integrator cabling not added: the Pricing Input '{input}' is not set.

kinds.label: Dismantling and refixing of an existing VAV box
Dismantling of an existing VAV box
Refixing of an existing VAV box

lines.priced: {label}: installation {rate} x {factor} (Pricing Input '{input}') = {figure}, supply 0 - no extras on a row of work on an existing box.
lines.with_row: Dismantling is priced on its own row of this sheet ({rows}) - refixing alone at x {factor}.
lines.alone: No separate dismantling row naming VAV on this sheet - refixing priced at x {factor}.
lines.input_missing: Work on an existing box: the Pricing Input '{input}' is not set - price this row by hand.

combination_warning.line: This rate combines the box with {n} extras (Rs {x} of Rs {y}). Review each item before using.
combination_warning.line_one: This rate combines the box with 1 extra (Rs {x} of Rs {y}). Review each item before using.
combination_warning.input_missing: This rate combines the box with extras. Review each item before using (the Pricing Input 'VAV - combination warning share' is not set).

vav_own_row_threshold.name: VAV - own-row threshold
vav_own_row_threshold.unit: share of the VAV boxes' quantity (0.9 = 90%)
vav_own_row_threshold.remarks: An extra a VAV box row prices that the SAME sheet also charges on its own row: that row's quantity at or above this share of the VAV rows' quantity -> not added (a note names the rows); below -> added with 'possible double counting' (owner 2026-11-18 23:32; QR-4 (a) 2026-11-19 00:57, Ducting's 90%).

vav_cabling_m_per_box.name: VAV - integrator cabling metres per box
vav_cabling_m_per_box.remarks: On a sheet with a VAV integrator and no separate VAV cabling row, the helper adds this many metres of the Integrator cabling SKU per box (owner 2026-11-18 23:14 "2 mts of cabling per VAV"; 2026-11-19 12:55 "the 2m is a pricing input sheet, the SKU remains the same").

vav_cabling_length_threshold.name: VAV - cabling length check
vav_cabling_length_threshold.unit: share of metres per box x VAV boxes (0.7 = 70%)
vav_cabling_length_threshold.remarks: The separate VAV cabling rows' metres below this share of (metres per box x the sheet's VAV boxes) -> the note also asks to check the cabling quantity; the price never changes (owner 2026-11-19 01:39).

vav_existing_dismantle.name: VAV - dismantling only
vav_existing_dismantle.remarks: Dismantling an existing VAV box: the installation rate x this, supply 0 (owner 2026-11-18 23:49 "only dismatling same as installtion").

vav_existing_dismantle_refix.name: VAV - dismantling and refixing
vav_existing_dismantle_refix.remarks: Dismantling and refixing an existing VAV box in one row: the installation rate x this, supply 0 (owner 2026-11-18 23:49 "dsimatling and refixing 1.5 times").

vav_existing_refix_with_dismantling.name: VAV - refixing (dismantling on its own row)
vav_existing_refix_with_dismantling.remarks: Refixing an existing VAV box when the sheet has a separate dismantling row naming VAV (owner 2026-11-18 23:49 "only refixing 0.5 times if dismantling seprate row").

vav_existing_refix_alone.name: VAV - refixing (no dismantling row)
vav_existing_refix_alone.remarks: Refixing an existing VAV box when the sheet has no separate dismantling row (owner 2026-11-18 23:49 "else 1.5").

vav_combination_warning_share.name: VAV - combination warning share
vav_combination_warning_share.unit: share of the box's own rate (0.5 = 50%)
vav_combination_warning_share.remarks: A VAV row whose extras come to more than this share of the box's own rate (supply + installation) shows a warning to review it; no figure changes (owner 2026-11-19 12:49 / 12:55 "option b" / 12:59 "ok proceed with 50%").
